title: Choose your own media upload ID
summary:
Custom media IDs and consistent model names arrived alongside a way to recover generations caught between a saved result and a failed coordinator call.

Media uploads now accept an optional account-scoped custom ID. Uploads remain create-only: reusing an ID returns 409 rather than replacing a file.

Public model IDs were standardized as lowercase `publisher/model` names across catalogs and generation routes. Existing IDs remain request aliases, and model-restricted keys continue to recognize saved aliases. API examples now use specific current IDs.

Enter and apps now share an account menu with clearer controls for connecting, getting and buying Pollen. App links still point to the appropriate Quests and Pollen pages.

daily.title: Name your media uploads
daily.text: Set an optional custom ID in `POST /upload` with a user-owned API key. IDs are scoped to your account, and an existing ID returns `409` instead of replacing a file. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Consistent model IDs
daily.text: Public models now use lowercase `publisher/model` IDs across the catalog and generation routes. Existing IDs still work as request aliases, including with model-restricted keys. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
